pathAssistantSteps.info:
Churned

The person belonged to a Flywire client account that has churned (is no longer a client).

Customer 

The person has a direct relationship to an Account that is a customer in account status of Client Signed or Active (Product Live).


Marketing Action:

The person receives general marketing outreach.


Sales Action: 

Contact Status is auto-updated when the contact has a direct relationship to an Account with an account status of Client Signed or Active (Product Live).


  • If this contact should be related to a different Account, please update the Account field.
  • If the Contact belongs under multiple Accounts, please add the new relationship under 'Related Accounts' and make sure the Direct Account is indicated with the appropriate checkbox. 


Client Success:

On-going outreach, Account Strategy, & QBRs to be completed by Relationship Manager/Client Success Team.

Disqualified 

The person does not meet qualification criteria and is not an influencer (e.g. Marketing Only status) at the account.


Sales Action: 

Update the status to Disqualified and select the Disqualification Reason.


  • Account Not Qualified: Flywire can not sell to the account 
  • Bad Email Address: Has an invalid email address; cannot receive emails
  • Competitor: Works for competing org
  • Country: Account is located in a country Flywire can not sell to
  • Data Missing: Not enough info on record to assess
  • Marked Inactive: No longer works for Account
  • No Response: Sales attempted to contact at least 3 times with no response
  • Payer: Payer looking for guidance 
  • Account Too

Engaged Status

The person has engaged with Flywire through Marketing outreach and is in the process of being warmed up by Marketing. 


Marketing Action:

Continue outreach to warm up the prospect.


Sales Action: 

No action needed unless you'd like to start working the prospect. If you do start working the prospect, set the Lead Person Status to Sales Working Lead (SWL).

Marketing Qualified Lead (MQL) Status

A person that Marketing has qualified as a potential customer and has been passed over to Sales to attempt working.


Marketing Action:

The person receives general marketing outreach.


Sales Action: 

Within 24 hours of the lead hitting MQL status – determine if the prospect is qualified for continued sales development.

  • If qualified, change the Lead Person Status to Sales Working Lead (SWL). 
  • If the person is qualified but not interested in buying within the next 6 months, change the Lead Person Status to Nurture. 
  • If person is at an account but is not involved in the buying decision, change Lead Person Status to Marketing Only. 
  • If the person is not qualified set to Disqualified and identify the Disqualification Reason.

Marketing Only

The person belongs to an Account that Flywire can sell to but the person will NOT be actively prospected by sales or involved in the sales process. In Marketing Only status, the person will continue to receive marketing communications but will no longer be considered a viable prospect for Sales to follow-up with.


Marketing Action:

The person receives general marketing outreach only.


Sales Action: 

Set prospect's Lead Person Status to 'Marketing Only' if person is at an account but is not involved in the buying decision.

Nurture

The person is qualified for a future sales opportunity but is not interested in buying within the next 6 months. Sales or marketing can move the prospect to this status to warm them up for future sales outreach.  


Marketing Action:

Marketing send outreach to warm-up the prospect. 


Sales Action: 

No action needed unless you'd like to start working the prospect. If you do start working the prospect, set the Lead Person Status to Sales Working Lead (SWL).

Opportunity 

The person has been assigned as an Opportunity Contact Role in a New Business Opportunity. 


Marketing Action:

The person receives general marketing outreach.


Sales Action: 

Work the Open Opportunity. Contact Status is auto-updated when the contact is related to the New Business opportunity.


If this contact should be related to a New Business Opportunity, please add them as an Opportunity Contact Role under that record.

Partner

The person belongs to a Partner account.

Renewal 

The person has been assigned as an Opportunity Contact Role in an open, Renewal Opportunity at a Flywire Client Account. 


Marketing Action:

The person receives general marketing outreach.


Client Success Action:

In some cases, CS will identify Account interest in new products/features, account health, and assist in renewal.


Sales Action: 

Work the Open Opportunity. Contact Status is auto-updated when the contact is related to an open, Renewal Opportunity.


If this contact should be related to a Renewal Opportunity, please add them as an Opportunity Contact Role under that record.

Sales Qualified Lead (SQL) Status

Sales has confirmed buyer intent within the next 6 months & meets criteria for a First Meeting.


Sales Action: 

Have the First Meeting. Actively engage via trackable outreach activities (meetings, emails, tasks, calls) to confirm the fitness of the account for Opportunity. 

  • If the person is qualified but not interested in buying within the next 6 months, change the Lead Person Status to Nurture. 
  • If account qualified, open a New Business Opportunity. 
  • If from an account but is not involved in the buying decision, change Lead Person Status to Marketing Only. 
  • If the person is not qualified set to Disqualified and identify the Disqualification Reason.


* The person will be sent to Nurture status if there is no sales activity after 60 days.

Sales Working Lead (SWL) Status

The person is actively worked by Sales to determine if they can be progressed into the opportunity process. 


Sales Action: 

Actively engage the prospect via trackable outreach activities (Yesware emails, Salesforce tasks & calls) to determine the fitness of the prospect for Opportunity.

  • If the person is qualified but not interested in buying within the next 6 months, change the Lead Person Status to Nurture. 
  • If qualified, change the Lead Person Status to Sales Qualified Lead (SQL). 
  • If from an account but is not involved in the buying decision, change Lead Person Status to Marketing Only. 
  • If the person is not qualified set to Disqualified and identify the Disqualification Reason.

* The person will be sent to Nurture status if there is no sales activity after 60 days.

Unverified Status

This status is the default when a new person record is created in Salesforce. This person has NOT engaged with Flywire.


Marketing Action:

Marketing begins outreach to warm up the prospect.


Sales Action: 

No action needed unless you'd like to start working the prospect. If you do start working the prospect, set the Lead Person Status to Sales Working Lead (SWL).

Upsell

The person has been assigned as an Opportunity Contact Role in an open, Existing Business Opportunity at a Flywire Client Account. 


Marketing Action:

The person receives general marketing outreach.


Client Success Action:

In some cases, CS will identify Account interest in new products/features for upsell and bring AE into conversation.


Sales Action: 

Work the Open Opportunity. Contact Status is auto-updated when the contact is related to an open, Existing Business Opportunity.


If this contact should be related to a Existing Business Opportunity, please add them as an Opportunity Contact Role under that record.
